crossRefs.note: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all…
But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
and walked in the statutes of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of…
Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds…
It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named…
For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation…
“But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,
and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in…
They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to…
Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says Yahweh.
They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other…
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

translations.web: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’
translations.bsb: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her. For her people have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.’
translations.kjv: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked
translations.asv: And she hath rebelled against mine ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are round about her; for they have rejected mine ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.
